symptom: A SNIPPETCALL inside a snippet that passes the enclosing snippet's own parameter (`snippetcall sc1 (Snippet: WorkflowCommons.Snip_UserTask_TaskTimeline, Params: {WorkflowUserTask: $Task})` in a snippet declaring $Task) is written with the argument in the PageParameter slot of the mapping's Forms$PageVariable; mx check 11.14.0: CE0115 "The arguments that are passed to snippet ... do not match the expected parameters and need to be refreshed." (ako/mxcli#721 L3, snippet-call sibling found in review of #823).
cause: widget_write.go's SnippetCallWidget case built the mapping's PageVariable by hand with SetPageParameterQualifiedName, the same hard-coded page slot #823 removed from the association and template-parameter writers; its enumeration of Forms$PageVariable writers missed this one because it does not go through sourceVariableToGen. pages.SnippetParamMapping had no slot information.
fix: buildSnippetCallParams classifies the argument with classifyFlowArgValue and sets IsSnippetParameter for kind snippet; the writer routes the mapping through sourceVariableToGen. Tests: TestSnippetCallParams_SnippetParameterSlot, TestSnippetCallMappingVariableSlot (page-parameter controls). mx check on a TestApp copy: CE0115 before, 0 errors after.
insight: To enumerate writers of an element, grep for its constructor (genPg.NewPageVariable), not for the helper that is supposed to wrap it: a hand-built instance is exactly the one that kept the old default. Studio Pro content showed 27 Forms$SnippetParameterMapping with a SnippetParameter slot in TestApp, invisible to the round-trip harness because describe does not print snippetcall Params at all.
